positions.position: Suggested online payments and booking advance.
Opposed payments on site due to complexity, preferring direct messaging.

conflicts.resolution: Online payments excluded from scope; direct WhatsApp messaging will be used instead.

dimensions.justification: Clear business goals to boost tourism and measurable 30-day targets (30 WhatsApp inquiries, 15 bookings) defined.
Audience identified (regional tourists from Hyderabad/Bangalore, mobile users, English and Telugu languages).
All three sponsors' needs captured: homestay inquiries/rates, restaurant menu/directions, tour schedule/safety.
Single-page structure defined with explicit sections and content details for all three businesses.
Features fully detailed including direct WhatsApp chat links, maps integration, listings, and content editing.
All MUST requirements have testable Given/When/Then acceptance criteria with explicit observable outcomes.
Content ownership, photo optimization, delivery deadline (by end of week), and language responsibilities defined.
Color scheme specified (ocean blues and sandy beige) for cove theme, but reference sites and logos not detailed.
Sub-3s mobile 4G load time, WebP compression, and Lighthouse score 85+ specified, but accessibility details absent.
Budget ($400 total), deadline (next month), domain/hosting allocation, handover to Lakshmi, and out-of-scope set.

out_of_scope: Online payments and online booking system

acceptance_criteria: Given a user visits the website on mobile or desktop, when they click a business's WhatsApp button, then WhatsApp opens immediately pre-filled with a draft message addressed to that specific business's phone number with dedicated links per business.
requirements.description: Dedicated WhatsApp button for each business section to open direct chat pre-filled with a draft message.
requirements.title: Direct WhatsApp Messaging

acceptance_criteria: Given a user views the website on mobile or desktop, when navigating via the anchor menu or scrolling, then dedicated sections for Sea Breeze Homestay, Ravi's Fish Kitchen, and Cove Boat Tours are displayed with business details, photos, operational info, and direct WhatsApp buttons.
requirements.description: Single-page layout displaying section listings for homestay rooms/rates, restaurant menu/timings, and boat tour schedules/safety.
requirements.title: Single-Page Business Listings

acceptance_criteria: Given a user taps the 'Get Directions' button or map section, when selected, then Google Maps launches with exact GPS coordinates for Velugu Cove pre-set as the destination, while step-by-step landmark directions are displayed directly on the page.
requirements.description: Written landmark driving directions from the main highway junction and Google Maps integration with pre-set destination coordinates.
requirements.title: Driving Directions & Google Maps Integration

acceptance_criteria: Given a user accesses the site on a standard 4G mobile connection, when the page loads, then full interactive load occurs within 3 seconds, achieving a Lighthouse mobile performance score of 85+ with WebP compressed images.
requirements.description: Sub-3 second interactive page load on 4G mobile connection using WebP image compression and high performance score.
requirements.title: Mobile Performance Optimization

acceptance_criteria: Given an owner needs to update room rates or food prices, when editing the lightweight CMS or spreadsheet file, then updates reflect on the site without requiring developer intervention or extra fees.
requirements.description: Lightweight editing system (e.g., Google Sheet or markdown/CMS) for updating rates, menus, and operating info without developer fees.
requirements.title: Non-Technical Content Editing

requirements.description: Website content available in English and Telugu for regional visitors.
requirements.title: Multilingual Support
